## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, creating a clash between broad sector participation and rising risk signals; VXX in ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) ↑ rising and SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) ↓ falling while breadth is strong, supporting the CAUTION call.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear rising: VXX in ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) ↑ rising; Stocks vs Bonds skewed risk-off as SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) ↓ falling vs TLT in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) ↑ rising; credit signals mixed—HYG in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.26%) ↑ flat while Credit Spread metric is ↓ falling.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Tilt toward tighter conditions: Yield curve metric ↑ rising (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND and duration preference rising; Dollar showing RECOVERY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -2.22%) RECOVERY so FX impact is neutral-to-slightly supportive for risk assets.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and commodity-linked sectors leading: XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) and XLB in ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%) showing strength while XLK in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%) and XLF in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -2.29%) showing weakness — style: commodity/cyclicals over growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
Global pockets outperforming US: EEM in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +5.84%) and EWJ in ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.98% | 1M: +10.36%) while SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) lags; China FXI in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -4.27%) remains weak.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative appetite cooling: IBIT in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -29.71%) and ARKK in BELOW TREND (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -15.56%) show risk-off positioning; IWM in BELOW TREND (1W: -0.78% | 1M: -0.09%) also soft.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Gold holding bid: GLD in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%) ↑ rising; industrial commodities mixed with CPER in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -5.17%) ↓ falling and soybean SOYB in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.82%) ↑ rising.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing clear strength: XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) ↑ rising, while natural gas UNG is in CORRECTION (1W: -6.25% | 1M: +21.48%) — watch volatility and divergence between oil and natgas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed uptrends: TLT in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%) and XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) — Major divergence: VXX rising and TLT strong versus SPY and XLK below trend, signaling mixed signals rather than a clean regime shift.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals/commodity exposure (XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%) and XLB in ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%)) and maintain bond hedge via TLT in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.49% | 1M: +1.96%); reduce exposure to tech (XLK in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%)) and lagging financials (XLF in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -2.29%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%), XLB in ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%). BEARISH: XLK in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%), XLF in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -2.29%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: GLD in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +8.61%). BEARISH: CPER in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -5.17%) and SLV in BELOW TREND (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -17.55%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~29 (↑ rising) as a fear pivot; HYG/LQD small gains (HYG in ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +0.26%)) vs Credit Spread ↓ falling as a watch-item; XLK/XLF ratio 2.70 (↑ rising) as growth vs financials leadership indicator.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, but rising VXX and SPY/TLT deterioration create conflicting signals. Energy and materials (XLE in ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +13.09%), XLB in ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +9.35%)) showing relative strength. Key risk: rising VXX in ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +7.81%) alongside SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -1.25%) — monitor tech weakness (XLK in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -3.55%)).
